notes.title: Update 0.3.1
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone, I'm a developer. [/b]

It's been about two weeks since the release of the demo version. Just before the release of the demo version, we started planning for the full version, and gradually the whole picture of the game started to become visible. It looks like I'll be able to start working on it soon, so I've fixed the things that need to be fixed before that. I'll list the two things that stood out to me below.

[h1]"Improve enemy information for clarity"[/h1].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41339651/731c1ed1c26c653b6bacbe9c5b0f44e24c347e13.png[/img].
One particular complaint I had with the 0.3.0 version was that the sound you hear when you defeat an enemy was too long and not very exhilarating, and it was hard to understand what was happening. So we've revised the overall feedback you get from fighting enemies. We'd really appreciate it if you could give us your feedback!
Specifically, when you hover the mouse cursor over an enemy, information about the enemy will now be displayed near the mouse. We are very happy with this change. Also, the sound effects for damaging and defeating enemies are now arcade-style, and particles are now generated. It looks better when a chain of items is triggered, for example!

[h1]"The home screen is easier to understand, even at first glance"[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41339651/32edd8e75ad9c77889ab0770135009a6a4cebb95.png[/img]
In addition to the above, the response to the buttons on the home screen was also felt to be unpredictable, so when the mouse cursor is hovered over a button, a speech bubble is displayed to show what will happen.
The home screen is the first game screen that a player touches, so we want to design it in such a way that it feels as polite as possible. We're looking for your feedback here too!

These are the only two changes we've made in this update that will be reflected in your experience, but we're working on a variety of useful features for future development. However, we are working on various useful features for future development.

One of the major changes we are planning to make is to change the images of the characters during conversations from Live2D to images only. If we can reflect this change in the demo version, we would like to do so.

We'll let you know when we make another update. Have a great holiday season!

[u]AMay[/u].
